page.overview:
Who is Erian Boroleos?

Erian is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful. She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.

Erian is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of the series. She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

Erian is from Illian and is 49 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After spending seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 978 NE. She had four Warders, but two of them were killed by Rand al'Thor. The other two are named Rashan and Bartol. Galina Casban, the Highest of the Red Ajah, became infatuated with Erian., Galina Casban}}

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. She is part of the White Tower embassy that makes an alliance with the Shaido.
